content.title: DraftKings Stock Is Under Pressure. Insiders See a Buying Opportunity.
content.summary: DraftKings  stock has trailed behind the broader market this year amid stiff competition in the online sports betting market.  Former Metro-Goldwyn Meyer CEO Harry Sloan, who has been on the board of  DraftKings  since April 2020, bought 25,000 shares for roughly $30.30 each, or $757,500 in total, according to a Form 4 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday.  The transaction brought the number of shares he held directly to 249,712, valued at some $7.87 million based on Wednesday’s closing price of $31.51.
